name: Dynamic Cards
description: Editorial card grid with a section header, staggered fade-in cards, optional images, colored call-to-action buttons, and a toggle to remove or restore each card image.
contents: Header with eyebrow, subtitle, title and description
Responsive grid of cards with index number, optional image, subtitle, title, body and optional CTA link
behavior: Cards fade and slide in with a staggered delay
Hover reveals the image in color, zooms it, tints the title and draws an accent line
Each card has a button that removes the image or restores a placeholder, switching the card to a text-only layout with a striped pattern
Grid goes from 1 to 4 columns by screen width

props.name: description
props.default: A rigid, dark-mode technical matrix balancing editorial elegance with structural modularity.

editableByProps: Header texts, number of cards, card texts, images, links and CTA style

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or change CTA button color styles

fixed: Image remove and restore toggle is built in and applies per card
CTA variant values are primary, secondary, warning, success, danger
Uses Tailwind animate-in utilities for the entrance animation
